title: Yellow Rich Venezuelan Chocolate Stew
description: A rich and creamy one-pot Venezuelan dish featuring plain chocolate and shio-cure, this stew is perfect for a cold evening. The resinous flavor of the chocolate pairs well with the savory elements of the dish.
instructions: Heat the shio-cure in a large pot over medium heat until fragrant.
Add the plain chocolate to the pot and stir until melted and smooth.
Add the beef broth, heavy cream, dried thyme, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the sliced carrots and cubed potatoes to the pot and continue to simmer for an additional 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew cool slightly before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for later use.
